name: BLOODSONG
source:
I awaken beside her in the decayed observatory. Shadows crawl along the walls, and blood-light seeps through. I know her, but how well?

[From [url=https://elzibeht.itch.io/bloodsong]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
我在腐烂的天文台里在她身边醒来。阴影沿着墙壁爬行，血光渗透进来。我认识她，但了解到什么程度呢？

[来自[url=https://elzibeht.itch.io/bloodsong]Itch.io[/url]]
